msg: Pick a random gnome to start with. If it has a good score e.g., 3-5 continue with that one until it goes down to 0, then pick the other one. The colours do not make a difference. If you lose concentration then just pick a gnome and see how the score is. Sometimes you may pick one which gives you 1 and then chose the other and it also gives you 1. I just kept going with one of them; if you repeatidly get 1 then change. Dont forget to click space, it is harder than you think.
